rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest case: chunk 4 (L25-30) carries only two bullets plus a one-line kicker — thinnest chunk in the file. Each bullet still carries a self-standing claim (the no-last-turn chain; kit-vs-model contrast), and the maintainer's L34 accept-note explicitly authorises the shape: 'The closing slide is two bullets plus a kicker, below the 3-bullet floor by design: the arc-final beat is two claims, and padding would be restatement.' Not a wait-state or context-dependent fragment. Chunks 1-3 each carry 3 bullets or 3 paragraphs of independent content.

Closest case: chunk 2 header 'The right information grounds and makes quality' (L10) against its content (L12-16). The paragraph's own argument (spec/tests as the 'grounding' written-down information that lets you 'know the system works', L12; broadened to 'the right information' generally, L14-16) supports the header's claim rather than contradicting it — the header is this slide's thesis stated as a claim, not a mismatched label. Chunks 1, 3, 4 headers are near-verbatim restatements of their own opening bullet, the tightest possible self-carry.

Checked every sub-item against the full body. Anaphora triple: L27 'Each session surfaces the next gap. Each gap proposes the next move. Each move makes the next session cheaper.' repeats the 'Each __' opener three times, but each leg introduces a NEW concrete link in a causal chain (session->gap->move->cheaper-session) rather than restating one claim three ways, which is the rule's own escape clause ('third leg carries NEW concrete content or cut to a pair'). L8's 'A push-back becomes a rule. A "not like that" becomes a check.' is the sanctioned PAIR form, not a triple. 'Not X. Not Y. Z.': not present — L7's single 'Not the model.' is one negation fragment, not the two-Not construction. Self-grading superlatives: none (grepped 'one of the most', 'the most useful' etc. — zero hits). Number + retraction: none (no numeric claim followed by a hedge). Abstraction-noun stacks: none ('the bounded-window reality'-style coinages absent; body stays concrete — spec, rules, checks, plan, 500K lines, spec and tests). Verb triplets with an empty leg: none found.
